answer: An agent economy resists sybils the way ornithologists band falcons: credentials are issued only by a few stake-backed registrars, one unique band per agent. A registrar posts collateral; forging or duplicating an identity slashes that bond and revokes its license. Signals from unbanded agents carry no weight, so an attacker must out-stake the entire registry to add one fake voice - an attack as hopeless as chiseling new ground from basalt.
